kapak.alt: The speech banana and high-frequency loss

youtube.baslik: Which speech sounds does high-frequency hearing loss take away? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: On the speech banana, vowels are low-pitched and strong, while consonants such as s and f are high-pitched and weak. A person with high-frequency loss hears the vowels but misses these consonants; in Turkish, s and sh occur in many suffixes, so grammatical cues can be missed too.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Which speech sounds does high-frequency hearing loss take away?
bilgiler: Vowels are low and strong; consonants like s and f are high and weak.
With high-frequency loss, vowels are heard but these consonants are missed.
In Turkish, s and sh occur in many suffixes, so grammar cues can vanish.
